field_checks.summary: Table 2 PA-Win2 MIC/MBC rows and Supplement Table S1 rows are source-matched in the final activity file, but final activity_toxicity_evidence.json contains zero biofilm or time-kill activity entries and no explicit exclusions for those source-reviewed activity surfaces.

All 13 DBAASP fallback candidates remain unresolved_record with source_verified=0, authoritative linked row count 0, and authoritative ingest disabled; this preserves the database boundary but leaves no source-verified authoritative database record for release ingest.

Paper-final and packet-final JSON mirrors are byte-identical for shared final records; packet mechanism_evidence.json is byte-identical to mechanism_ontology_record.json. Final review open_rework_ticket_count is 0 and matches the live rework ledger state.

Mechanism ontology preserves evidence classes: only the DiSC3(5) membrane depolarization assay is direct_mechanism; time-kill and biofilm are phenotype_supported, RT-qPCR is inferred_mechanism, and in-silico discovery/modeling is computational_only.

Primary XML identifies the paper as PMC11672609, DOI 10.3390/antibiotics13121113, PMID 39766503. PA-Win2 sequence LLRGLRYLCLKILYILKLRK is present in Table 1 and Supplement Figure S4; no current final object contains both sequence and sequence_length, so no length mismatch was found.

Current MIC/MBC and toxicity rows have concrete XML/PDF/supplement locators, direct unit normalization where used, and exact/censored status preserved; fallback database provenance remains separated from source evidence.

Recursive authority is not present in the current final release boundary: fallback rows are candidate machine evidence only, source_verified count is 0, authoritative_dbaasp_ingest_ready is false, and no fallback row is promoted to RC2/portal/authoritative ingest.

No APD6/DBAASP/DRAMP authoritative linked rows are present, so cross-database conflicts are not evaluable. The final review preserves this as caution rather than smoothing fallback candidates into verified database records.

The staged supplement zip is readable and its single PDF member is extracted with 9 text pages, S1/S2/S3 tables, and S2 figure observations; however final activity_toxicity_evidence.json does not consume or explicitly exclude the source-reviewed supplementary anti-biofilm observations.

The final toxicity set preserves HaCaT no-observed-decrease through the highest tested concentration and hADMSC/HDFalpha viability decrease above 64 ug/mL with source locators. No selectivity index or HC50/CC50 value was promoted without source support.

blocking_findings.reason: Final activity_toxicity_evidence.json is not source-exhaustive for activity evidence. It contains 16 activity_records limited to MIC/MBC rows and has candidate_or_rejected_rows=[] and excluded_non_activity_table_entries=[], while the primary source reports time-kill activity and anti-biofilm/CV activity surfaces, and the staged supplement contains approximate S2 biofilm quantification observations. The final mechanism record classifies these as phenotypes, but layer-2 activity evidence still needs row-level activity records or explicit source-reviewed exclusions with locators and exact/approximate status.
required_actions: Reopen the XML/PDF and supplementary figure observation surfaces for Figure 3, Figure 6, and Supplement Figure S2.

Add source-located layer-2 activity/phenotype rows for time-kill and anti-biofilm/CV observations with endpoint, raw value/unit or explicit no-numeric rationale, target species/strain, concentration, assay conditions, source_locator, and exact_vs_approximate_status.

If any of these surfaces are intentionally out of scope for layer-2 activity, add explicit source-reviewed exclusion objects naming each locator and reason; do not rely on mechanism ontology claims as the only coverage.
acceptance_checks: A fresh field-level check over final/activity_toxicity_evidence.json finds either activity_records or explicit exclusions for xml:fig:3, xml:fig:6, and supp:antibiotics-3288224-supplementary.pdf:page=3:figure=S2 panels B and D.
No final activity/toxicity row has missing endpoint, target_species, target_strain_or_isolate where reported, raw_unit/no-unit rationale, source_locator, or exact_vs_approximate_status.
semantic_three_layer_gate.py and check_three_layer_publication_quality.py still pass after the repaired activity coverage, and open_rework_ticket_count remains equal to the live packet ticket state.

cautions.summary: Authoritative DBAASP/APD6/DRAMP linked rows are absent; 13 DBAASP machine fallback candidates are correctly preserved as unresolved_record and excluded from authoritative ingest.

Supplement Table S2 page 8 contains a visible layout artifact in the final biofilm-inhibition shaking-condition bacterial-cell-number cell; current extracted rows mark the affected observations approximate, which must remain preserved if promoted into final activity evidence.
